extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Qompass AI's agent runtime as an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28): bounded planner-coder-reviewer workflows in which the CLI, terminal UI, and MCP server share one safe runtime, with operator-approved named checks, a host-enforced verification gate, and the MATE joint-attention coordination board. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Phlow does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Phlow MCP Server

skills.description: Run a bounded local planner-coder-reviewer workflow with real file tools and a host-enforced verification gate: a run verifies only when the roles finish within their budgets, every required named check passes, edited files carry static-analysis evidence, and a separate read-only reviewer approves (flow_run).
skills.name: Bounded agent runs

skills.description: Read local health, configured models and checks, and editor capabilities, and run operator-configured named checks; arbitrary argv is never accepted (flow_status, flow_check).
skills.name: Status and named checks

skills.description: The MATE joint-attention coordination board: publish an agent's advertised focus with replay protection, read a partner agent's current focus, and compute alignment and coordination decisions (parallel, serialize, or reject a stale frame) between agents (flow_attention_publish, flow_attention_focus, flow_attention_alignment, flow_attention_decide).
skills.name: Joint attention board
